verdict.rationale: Loops' API supports POST /events/send to trigger workflows for a specific contact, and workflows can be built around product events (onboarding, activation, upgrade) tied to individual users via contact/email identifiers. Docs confirm events start published workflows and can be sent from backend, CLI, or SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of per-person targeting precision and no detailed example showing event payload scoping to one contact.
